scope: Synthetic/public READ-only proof; no real health data, clinical action, credential payload, or irreversible action
reality_chain: local worker POST Action Contract to n8n queue
n8n persists pending contract in workflow static state
local Ego worker polls n8n pull endpoint
bounded Ego runner executes public READ
local worker POSTs Receipt to n8n
n8n stores Receipt in workflow static state
transport_character: One-shot unattended worker script performed queue, pull, Ego execution, and receipt return without chat-mediated data relay between steps.
admission: R1 proves direct shadow transport for synthetic READ actions. It is not production-grade authentication and must not be used with real health data until an authenticated queue bridge is installed.
